# Tashkeel accuracy

Corpus: 152 sentences, 956 words. DER/WER in %, lower is better. Conventions: see `eval/metrics.py` (Arabic letters only; `all` = every letter, `gold-only` = letters that carry a diacritic in the gold text).

| Engine | Scope | DER w/ case | WER w/ case | DER w/o case | WER w/o case | internal DER | final (i'rab) DER | shadda err | words/s |
| :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| mock | all letters | 75.70 | 99.89 | 75.23 | 95.92 | 75.23 | 75.52 | 100.00 | 55368.3 |
| mock | gold-only | 84.39 | 99.16 | 87.58 | 95.92 | 87.58 | 70.97 | 100.00 | 55368.3 |
| fast | all letters | 10.76 | 37.34 | 6.86 | 17.57 | 6.48 | 25.84 | 11.18 | 289.7 |
| fast | gold-only | 12.75 | 35.46 | 7.64 | 15.17 | 7.14 | 30.40 | 11.18 | 289.7 |
| accurate | all letters | 3.58 | 14.12 | 2.75 | 8.47 | 2.59 | 6.59 | 4.79 | 229.0 |
| accurate | gold-only | 4.54 | 13.91 | 3.55 | 8.37 | 3.34 | 7.69 | 4.79 | 229.0 |
| accurate-nofilter | all letters | 3.33 | 13.07 | 2.43 | 7.32 | 2.27 | 6.59 | 4.79 | 704.7 |
| accurate-nofilter | gold-only | 4.20 | 12.76 | 3.12 | 7.11 | 2.91 | 7.69 | 4.79 | 704.7 |

## Notes
- Gold set: 152 original sentences / 956 words (`eval/gold/`, see `SOURCES.md`). Small: treat
  differences under ~1 point as noise; use `--corpus` with Tashkeela/Fadel data for real benchmarks.
- `accurate` = CATT + current conservative morph filter; `accurate-nofilter` = CATT alone.
  On this set the morph filter does **not** help (it slightly raises DER) - evidence for Task 7.1.4.
- Many remaining CATT errors on the gold set are convention/grammar slips: pausal sukun on
  `مِنْ/عَنْ/أَخَذَتْ` before `ال` (gold: `مِنَ/عَنِ/أَخَذَتِ`), missing hamza vowel in
  `إلَى/أنَّ`, and wrong i'rab.
- `mock` is a deterministic rule engine for CI, not a quality baseline.
- Throughput (`words/s`) was measured on a shared CPU box with the cache disabled and varies by run
  (not stored in `baseline.json`).
